title: Confirmation note field is labelled Note (Optional) and stops at 255
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOTE255-01) is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
  • You have the text {Note-A} ready to paste: 1234567890 written 30 times in a row (30 × 10 = 300 characters).
custom_steps:
1. Open {Part-A}, pick Part Status "Inactive" and click Save.
  2. Read the label of the note field.
  3. Paste {Note-A} into the note field.
  4. Read the end of the note field.
  5. Click "Deactivate", then open {Part-A}'s Part History.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The field is labelled "Note (Optional)".
  • Step 3: The field stops accepting characters at 255.
  • Step 4: It ends with 25 full blocks of 1234567890 and then "12345" (25 × 10 + 5 = 255 characters).
  • Step 5: The entry reads "Deactivated | Reason: " followed by those 255 characters, ending "12345". A note over 255 characters cannot be sent from this screen, so the refusal "A note cannot be longer than 255 characters." (an error that fades after 3 seconds) cannot be checked by hand: write 'not checked by hand' for it in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S10-R10, S10-N3, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 3.3 and 4.4 (the Note (Optional) field), 13 Oct copy.   • S10-N3: “If a note longer than 255 characters reaches the system by any route, the change is refused with "A note cannot be longer than 255 characters."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Note longer than 255 characters): “"A note cannot be longer than 255 characters." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
